info.title: Orphograph API
info.summary: Anchor a SHA-256 fingerprint to Bitcoin through OpenTimestamps and get a verifiable receipt.
info.description: A receipt proves WHEN a fingerprint existed: that a file or hash existed at a point in time. It does not establish who made it, who owns it, or that it is original, and it is not a notarisation or legal advice. File contents never reach the server: the client computes the SHA-256 and sends only the fingerprint. Verification is free and needs no account. This document covers the single-fingerprint lane an agent uses most and folder (agent-run) anchors; lineage is described in https://orphograph.com/llms.txt.

post.description: Free tier: three anchors per 24 hours per client, no account. Past it, send a Pack claim code (X-Pack-Token), a Standing Order API key (X-Orpho-Api-Key), or pay for this one anchor with x402. x402 runs on Base mainnet (eip155:8453) in USDC: one anchor costs 1 cent (amount 10000, USDC has 6 decimals), and GET /api/health shows the live x402.network and x402.price_atomic before you pay. One x402 authorization buys one anchor. Retrying is safe: resending the identical request (same signed authorization, same body) after it bought its anchor answers 200 with that same receipt, x402_replay: true and the original PAYMENT-RESPONSE header; nothing is anchored or charged again. The same authorization with any other body is refused with 401 and names no receipt.

parameters.name: X-Pack-Token
parameters.description: Claim code of a credit Pack; consumes one credit.

parameters.name: X-Orpho-Api-Key
parameters.description: API key of an active Standing Order subscription.

parameters.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
parameters.description: x402 v2 PaymentPayload, base64 JSON, carrying a signed EIP-3009 authorization for the exact amount named in the 402 challenge. X-PAYMENT is accepted as the legacy header name.

200.description: Anchored. calendars_ok counts the OpenTimestamps calendar servers that accepted the fingerprint; the Bitcoin attestation follows within hours and is visible on /api/verify.

400.description: Invalid body; the error names the field and the fix.

401.description: A credential or x402 authorization was refused: for example an authorization that already bought an anchor, presented with a different body. An identical retry is a 200, not a 401 (a private receipt is served that way only to its owner; anyone else gets this 401 with the receipt_id alone).

402.description: Free-tier limit reached and x402 is armed: the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header carries the x402 requirements as base64 JSON; the body repeats them with limit_per_day, retry_after_seconds and a hint.

415.description: POST bodies must be sent as Content-Type: application/json.

429.description: Free-tier limit reached; retry after Retry-After seconds, or use a Pack, a subscription, or x402.

503.description: Anchoring is temporarily unavailable; nothing was charged unless the body says otherwise.

get.summary: Receipt status from the office's record (free, no account).
get.description: Returns calendar attestation counts and, once pinned, btc_pinned_at: the time the office OBSERVED the Bitcoin pin, not the block's own timestamp. This endpoint does not check the chain itself; to do that without Orphograph, run an OpenTimestamps client over the receipt's .ots files (offline verifier: https://orphograph.com/verify/).

404.description: No receipt with that id (private receipts answer the same way to everyone but their owner).

get.summary: Check an output you received against a receipt (free, no account).
get.description: Send the SHA-256 of the output, computed by you. For a single anchor, match is true when it equals the anchored hash. For a folder or agent-run anchor, match is true when it equals one leaf's file digest; the answer then carries an inclusion proof for that leaf (RFC 6962 node hashing, the same proof /api/inclusion_proof serves) that you can recompute to anchored_hash_sha256 offline. When the receipt's paths are not visible to you, path_visible is false and the path is withheld; the proof starts from leaf_hex. A mismatch is still a 200 with match false. Shows this exact output existed by the anchor time. It does not show who produced it or that it is correct.

parameters.name: sha256
parameters.description: SHA-256 of the output, 64 hex characters (any case).

200.description: Checked; match says whether the output is covered.

400.description: Invalid receipt_id or sha256; the error names the field.

404.description: No receipt with that id (private receipts answer the same way to everyone but their owner).

post.summary: Anchor a folder or an agent run: one Merkle root over many file digests.
post.description: The client builds an orphograph-merkle-v1-rfc6962 manifest (one leaf per file: its relative path and SHA-256, computed by the client) and sends only the manifest; file contents never reach the server. The server re-derives every leaf and the root from the manifest and refuses one whose root does not follow from its leaves, then anchors the root exactly like /api/anchor. An agent run is the same call with leaf paths step-000001, step-000002, ... (one leaf per step output). Free tier, Pack and Standing Order apply as on /api/anchor; x402 is not accepted on this path. The body is either {manifest, ...options} or the raw manifest as the top-level object. Paths are shown only to the receipt's owner unless paths_public is true.

parameters.name: X-Pack-Token
parameters.description: Claim code of a credit Pack; consumes one credit.

parameters.name: X-Orpho-Api-Key
parameters.description: API key of an active Standing Order subscription.

200.description: Anchored. The response names the root and leaf count; fetch the receipt and manifest from /api/verify_folder/{receipt_id}.

400.description: Invalid body or manifest (a leaf or root that does not derive, a wrong-typed option, a body over 8 MB); the error names the problem. Nothing was charged.

402.description: private: true was asked without an active subscription; no anchor was made.

415.description: POST bodies must be sent as Content-Type: application/json.

429.description: Free-tier limit reached, too many rejected manifests from this address, or another folder anchor from this address is still in flight; retry after Retry-After seconds.

503.description: Anchoring is temporarily unavailable; nothing was charged.

get.summary: A folder or agent-run receipt with its stored manifest (free, no account).
get.description: Returns the receipt record and the manifest it anchored. With the manifest, anyone can recompute each leaf and the root offline and check the root against the receipt's .ots files. Leaf paths are withheld (paths_redacted: true) from everyone but the owner unless the receipt was anchored with paths_public; leaf digests, sizes and order are always shown.

400.description: The receipt exists but is a single-fingerprint anchor; use /api/verify/{receipt_id}.

404.description: No receipt with that id (private receipts answer the same way to everyone but their owner).

get.summary: Public anchor counts and calendar status.
get.description: Aggregate counts only: no receipt ids, labels, paths or accounts.

get.summary: Plain-text summary of the service for AI readers.

hash_hex.description: SHA-256 of the content, 64 lowercase hex characters, computed by the client.

sha512_hex.description: Optional SHA-512 of the same content, a second digest stored with the receipt.

client_label.description: Optional label of your own choosing. It is shown on the receipt; do not put secrets or personal data in it.

private.description: Subscribers only: keep the receipt out of public lookup.

notify_email.description: Paid anchors only: email the receipt to this address.

c2pa_manifest_hash.description: Optional SHA-256 of a C2PA manifest to bind to this receipt; echoed on verify.

metadata.description: Optional small JSON object stored with the receipt.

paths_public.description: Folder anchors only (/api/anchor_folder): publish the manifest's relative paths. Type-checked here and otherwise ignored.

zk_proof.description: Optional zero-knowledge proof that a fixed, published hash-chain procedure produced the output. It does not prove which model ran.

created_at.description: UTC time the office received the fingerprint (ISO 8601).

x402_settled.description: x402-paid anchors only: the payment settled before the anchor ran.

x402_payment_held.description: x402-paid anchors only: true when the anchor reached no calendar and the identical request may retry on the money already paid.

x402_replay.description: Present (true) only when this answer is an identical retry served the receipt its payment already bought.

btc_pinned_at.description: When the office observed the Bitcoin pin; not the block timestamp.

anchored_hash_sha256.description: The anchored hash: the fingerprint itself, or the folder's Merkle root.

btc_pinned_at_utc.description: When the office observed the Bitcoin pin; not the block timestamp.

matched_leaf_count.description: Folder anchors, on a match: how many leaves carry this digest.

path_visible.description: Folder anchors, on a match: whether the leaf path is shown to you.

path.description: The first matching leaf's path, only when path_visible.

inclusion_proof.description: Folder anchors, on a match: proof for the first matching leaf. proof is a list of [direction, sibling_hex] from the leaf upward; L puts the sibling on the left.

root_hex.description: The Merkle root; it must follow from the leaves (RFC 6962 hashing).

path.description: Relative POSIX path; step-NNNNNN for an agent run's steps.

scope.description: Optional: what the folder walk included and excluded, checked against its recorded hash.

signature.description: Optional Ed25519 signature over the manifest; if present it must verify.

client_label.description: Optional label of your own choosing, cut at 200 characters. It is shown on the receipt; do not put secrets or personal data in it.

private.description: Subscribers only: keep the receipt out of public lookup.

paths_public.description: Show the manifest's paths to anyone who views the receipt (default: owner only).

notify_email.description: Paid anchors only: email the receipt to this address.

office_signature.description: Office use only (the weekly Standing Record anchor). Other callers omit it; one that does not verify is refused with 400.

created_at.description: UTC time the office received the root (ISO 8601).

lineage.description: Present when the manifest carries a lineage block.

receipt.description: The receipt record (as /api/verify/{receipt_id}); hash_hex is the folder's Merkle root.

manifest.description: The stored manifest. When paths are withheld, each leaf carries index instead of path, and paths_redacted is true.

agent_label_anchors.description: Anchors whose client_label starts with agent- (any case).

run_anchors.description: Folder anchors whose every path is step-NNNNNN (agent runs).
